Check out this short video: Pirate's Rebellion. This unit is only available through the nominal fee option ($7,000 - for 1-5 days).
Don’t forget, with every unit, we provide:
• complete set-up and tear-down

• a supervisor and staffing for the entire event

• a certificate of insurance that lists you, the event holder, as additionally insured in a $3M policy

• a superb safety record for over two decades

• a fun-filled, family-friendly environment, adding a level of amusement to your event

We hope to join in your annual Estes Park celebration. Let us know how we can make that happen. If you have any questions, please let me know. We look forward to hearing from you and hope you have a phenomenal week. Take care,

notes.subject: Contact for 2027 multi-event Mini Zone partnership
notes.body: Contact Colorado Events after the 2026 Boulder Art Festival while results are fresh. Ask for the 2027 festival calendar and discuss a guarantee-first, multi-event Mini Zone/family attraction partnership. Confirm attendance, available off-mall or adjacent space, power, anchoring, permits, and whether one agreement could cover several Colorado Events festivals.

notes.subject: Organizer and venue details
notes.body: Organizer: Colorado Events. General contact: coloradoevents@gmail.com, 720-272-7467. Mailing address: 2525 Arapahoe Ave, E4-720, Boulder, CO 80302. Venue: Pearl Street Mall, Boulder, CO 80302. Boulder requires advance approval and licensing for amusements plus event insurance; published general requirement is $1 million per occurrence and $2 million aggregate. City reference: https://bouldercolorado.gov/guide/special-events

notes.subject: Adventure Zone opportunity strategy
notes.body: Promising 2027 lead, best approached as part of a multi-event Colorado Events relationship. Pitch a compact Mini Zone or official family-fun area using the guarantee arrangement first. The normal 10-attraction Adventure Zone package is probably too large for the occupied Pearl Street footprint unless the organizer can secure an adjacent plaza, closed side street, or nearby lot. Regular juried booths are limited to handmade art vendors, so Adventure Zone would need a custom sponsor/entertainment agreement. Published Pearl Street sponsorship pricing begins at $550 per event day with a two-day minimum ($1,100), but that appears booth-scale and does not guarantee inflatable space. Ask about a dedicated family area, usable footprint, power, anchoring, permits, 2027 dates, verified attendance, and a multi-event arrangement.

notes.subject: 2026 Boulder Art Festival research
notes.body: Verified event details: September 5–6, 2026 on all four blocks of the Pearl Street Mall in downtown Boulder. Public hours are Saturday 11:00 AM–7:00 PM and Sunday 11:00 AM–6:00 PM. Admission is free. The event advertises more than 90 artists plus live music. Colorado Events describes its shows as drawing thousands, but no trustworthy event-specific attendance total was published. The 2026 festival is sold out. Official event page: https://www.coloradoevents.org/boulderartfestival

history.body:
Hi,

My name is Amy, and I work with Dave. We represent The Adventure Zone and Pirate's Rebellion -- America's Best Inflatable Carnival! We’d love to come to your Handmade in Colorado event.

Our Adventure Zone units feature 10-12 amazing inflatable attractions, including thrilling obstacle courses, massive slides, exciting mazes, engaging carnival-style games, fun bouncy houses, and more. Check out this short video: Adventure Zone. To book this unit, we have 2 payment options.
• There is no up-front charge to you. Plus, we will pay a percentage of our ticket box sales back to you, the event holder (This option is only available when your event is 2-5 days long).

• We can offer our colorful attractions to your attendees for a nominal fee ($8,000 - for 1-5 days).

Or you can release your inner Pirate in our massive inflatable pool on paddle-style boats. Collect pirate coins, dodge sponges from other pirate ships, or ride down our super slide, bounce in our inflatable combo. Prepare to get wet, and don’t forget the carnival-style games. Check out this short video: Pirate's Rebellion. This unit is only available through the nominal fee option ($7,000 - for 1-5 days).
Don’t forget, with every unit, we provide:
• complete set-up and tear-down

• a supervisor and staffing for the entire event

• a certificate of insurance that lists you, the event holder, as additionally insured in a $3M policy

• a superb safety record for over two decades

• a fun-filled, family-friendly environment, adding a level of amusement to your event

We hope to join in your annual Estes Park celebration. Let us know how we can make that happen. If you have any questions, please let me know. We look forward to hearing from you and hope you have a phenomenal week. Take care,

Amy
The Adventure Zone

EMAIL: TheAdventureZone12@gmail.com
WEB: https://www.the-adventure-zone.com/
